name: Floating Dock
description: High-performance kinetic floating application dock with continuous C1-cosine proximity distribution, multi-directional orientation, and zero layout thrashing.

props.name: direction
props.label: Dock Direction / Orientation
props.description: Orientation and shelf alignment edge of the dock and tooltip positions.

props.name: baseSize
props.label: Base Item Size (px)
props.description: Default width and height of dock items at rest.

props.name: maxMagnification
props.label: Max Boost Factor
props.description: Maximum scale multiplier at zero distance.

props.name: influenceRadius
props.label: Influence Radius (px)
props.description: Influence spread of the Gaussian proximity curve.

props.name: showLabels
props.label: Show App Labels
props.description: Display macOS-style frosted tooltips on icon hover/focus.

props.name: panelStyle
props.label: Dock Panel Style
props.description: Visual backing shelf styling of the dock.

react.description: Floating Dock — Clean Shadcn-style component powered by @exhuma/core kinetic primitives.

nextjs.description: Floating Dock — Clean Shadcn-style component powered by @exhuma/core kinetic primitives.

vue.description: Floating Dock — Vue 3 Composition API with reactive Gaussian proximity math and directional tooltips.

svelte.description: Floating Dock — Svelte 5 component with runes ($state, $derived) and native rAF kinetic scaling.
svelte.code:
{#each items as item, idx}
(hoveredTitle = item.title)} onpointerleave={() => (hoveredTitle = null)} class="relative flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full cursor-pointer" style="width: {baseSize}px; height: {baseSize}px;" > {#if hoveredTitle === item.title}
{item.title}
{/if}
{item.title.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
{/each}

angular.description: Floating Dock — Angular 18+ Standalone Component with signal inputs, direct DOM rendering, and rAF proximity interpolation.

solid.description: Floating Dock — SolidJS fine-grained reactivity with direct DOM manipulation and zero re-render overhead.

astro.description: Floating Dock — Astro component with self-hydrating client script and pure CSS/rAF magnification.

wordpress.description: WordPress Gutenberg block metadata for Floating Dock.
wordpress.code:
{
  "$schema": "https://schemas.wp.org/trunk/block.json",
  "apiVersion": 3,
  "name": "exhuma/floating-dock",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "title": "Floating Dock",
  "category": "widgets",
  "description": "High-performance kinetic floating application dock with continuous cosine proximity distribution.",
  "attributes": {
    "direction": { "type": "string", "default": "bottom" },
    "baseSize": { "type": "number", "default": 36 },
    "maxMagnification": { "type": "number", "default": 0.75 },
    "influenceRadius": { "type": "number", "default": 60 }
  },
  "editorScript": "file:./index.js",
  "render": "file:./render.php"
}
